# Approaches

Every style choice as a menu. Each dimension lists the options the sources use, what each is good and weak at, and what a reel made that way looks like. Clashes live here as options, not problems. [index](../index.md)


## Content

- [Hook method](hook-method.md): How much do we engineer the opening lines? (Triple hook: context, lean, snapback · Say something crazy and get into it · Statement, reason, re-hook, 'Why?' · Three hooks at once: title, verbal, visual · Cold open on later highlights · Proven template, fill the blanks)
- [Hook type](hook-type.md): What kind of first line or first image is it? (Contrarian take / 'Don't buy X' · Curiosity question or 'do this now' · Contrast: looks X, sounds Y / before vs after · Proof or verdict first · Undercut a paid offer · Expertise hook: years of X in 60 seconds · Warning hook: never start X without these N things · Desire hook: this is exactly what you want to see · Promise hook: daily habit, three payoffs)
- [Hook lean](hook-lean.md): After the context, what makes the viewer want the next sentence? (Proof: a stat, screenshot or result · Pain point or benefit · Shocking or unexpected fact · Bold contrarian statement · Odd pattern interrupt)
- [Hook clarity](hook-clarity.md): Must everyone get the opening instantly, or can it be for insiders? (Understood in one Mississippi · Not everyone gets it · Line 1 teases, line 2 explains)
- [Claim size](claim-size.md): How big a claim do we make? (Small, sincere, provable · Bold claim, instant proof · Best or worst: green or red, never grey · Bold reel with an honest limitation)
- [Core idea type](core-idea.md): What kind of thought is the reel built on? (Strong take · Strong take, then teach · Small epiphany · Story time · Humour / poke fun)
- [Content mechanism](content-mechanism.md): What is the reel's engine: teaching, testing, ranking, busting, or a series? (Tutorial / do-this-now · Myth-bust / proof reel · Challenge / experiment · Rating, tier list or versus · Series / monthly franchise)
- [List approach](list-approach.md): Do we use lists, and what kind? (No generic lists · 4–5 mini takes · Numbered blitz / utility listicle · Rating / tier list · List as a carousel)
- [Teaser vs give everything](teaser-vs-give-all.md): Does the reel give the whole thing, or hold some back? (Give everything, right here · Show part, comment for the rest · Give it all, DM the extra · Hyper-edited teaser for a long piece)
- [Audience width](audience-width.md): How wide or narrow is the audience the hook calls out? (Widen one layer · Hyper-specific or hyper-local · Start narrow, expand in layers (80/20) · Wide on top of funnel, narrow lower down)
- [Language](language.md): Which language do we speak and write in? (English speech and text · Hinglish speech, English captions · Hinglish throughout · Switch by theme)
- [Post caption length](caption-length.md): How long is the written caption under the post? (Short: two lines or less · Long candid note · Structured: hook, value, CTA, keywords · Long, but in short paragraphs)

## Visual craft

- [On-screen caption style](caption-style.md): How do the burned-in captions look, if there are any? (Word by word, key word in a coloured box · Plain white with soft shadow, no box · Uppercase caption bar between halves · Custom kinetic text (not captions) · No burned captions, title only)
- [Font pairing / type style](font-pairing.md): What typefaces and colour accents do titles and labels use? (Clean sans, red/green coding · Serif accent plus sans body · Extended wide sans, neon highlights · Brush script plus heavy extruded sans · Heavy condensed caps labels, one accent)
- [Colour grade look](colour-grade.md): What overall colour mood does the footage have? (Warm golden · Moody, desaturated · High contrast with neon accents · Cool, contrasty, textured · Dark matte with one accent colour)
- [Grade blacks](grade-blacks.md): Are the blacks lifted, deep, or in between? (Lifted, soft blacks · Deep, high-contrast blacks · Slight lift, neutral)
- [On-screen layout](on-screen-layout.md): How is the 9:16 frame divided? (Full-frame face with pop-up labels · Framed graphic yap · Split: graphic top, face bottom · Content card plus circular face cam · Full-screen content, no face)
- [Visual density](visual-density.md): How many things are on screen at once? (One element carries it · Layered: audio, visual and text together · Calm camera, busy overlays · Chaotic: memes, layouts and images every 1–2 s)
- [Polish level](polish-level.md): How produced is the reel? (Full polish · Polish the key beats only · Just trimmed · Polish by platform)
- [Motion style](motion-style.md): How do zooms, pans and graphics move? (Linear (constant speed) · Eased: entrances ease out, exits ease in · Spring with slight overshoot · Static shots, hard cuts)
- [Counter and motion-graphic usage](motion-graphics.md): Which motion graphics carry information? (None or minimal · Counters and progress badges · Data cards, stamps and price strikes · Proof cards on the exact word · Signature effects: text behind head, B&W freeze, memes)
- [Transition style](transition-style.md): How does one shot or section move to the next? (Hard cuts on beat or motion · Whip pan · Kinetic wipes and board zooms · Glitch, colour bars, CRT static · Reveal moves and trend transitions)
- [Edit pace](edit-pace.md): How often does something on screen change? (Hyper: shots under 2 s · Fast: a change every 1.2–2.5 s · Overlay-driven, slow camera · Measured: 2.5–4.5 s shots · Long takes)
- [Punch-in zoom style](punch-in-zoom.md): How do we zoom for emphasis on a talking shot? (No punch-ins · Subtle 105–110% · Big 1.15–1.3× on punchlines · Axial jump cuts every 3–6 words · Push-ins on percussive hits)

## Sound

- [SFX style and density](sfx-style.md): Which sound effects, and how many? (A sound on every visual event · Sparse accents on key beats · Cinematic impacts and risers · Meme stingers · No SFX, dialogue only)
- [Music approach](music-approach.md): What role does music play? (Quiet bed under the voice · Trending audio added in-app · Music-led, cut to the beat · Music changes by section, with dropouts · Voice only, no declared music)

## Filming

- [Face vs faceless](face-vs-faceless.md): Is a face on camera, and how much? (Expert on camera · Face as a small cameo · Hands-only POV with voiceover · Motion graphics only · B-roll plus text, no voice)
- [Talking format](talking-format.md): If someone talks, in what setting and shape? (Standard yap · Walking or car yap · Graphic yap · Podcast or conversation clip · Pause-and-play breakdown)
- [Length choice](length-choice.md): How long is the piece? (6–15 s proof or vibe reel · 30–60 s value reel · 60–120 s story or build · 2–3 min long reel · Long form (YouTube))
- [Set approach](set-approach.md): Where are we filmed, and does it change? (One fixed signature set · Rotating sets as pattern interrupts · Real places as sets · A backdrop that teaches)

## Strategy

- [CTA approach](cta-approach.md): What does the end of the reel ask the viewer to do? (Comment KEYWORD, get it by DM · No DM needed, it's all here · Conversation CTA: your takeaway · Send this to... · To a landing page or email list)
- [CTA frequency](cta-frequency.md): How often do posts ask for something or sell? (A keyword CTA on nearly every reel · Weekly rhythm: 4 reach, 2 deep, 1 sell · Rarely sell in organic content)
- [Comment and DM handling](reply-handling.md): Who answers comments and delivers DMs? (Auto-DM on keyword · Reply yourself · Auto-deliver, personal replies)
- [Posting cadence](posting-cadence.md): How often do we post? (About one reel a day · Three a week, pillar system · Accordion: volume first, then effort · Sustainable baseline and a bank)
- [Cross-posting](cross-posting.md): Does one cut go everywhere, or is each platform edited separately? (Master one, cross-post the rest · Native re-edit per platform · Waterfall one long piece · One platform in focus at a time)
- [Success metric](success-metric.md): Which number tells us a post worked? (Hook rate and skip rate first · Multiple of your own baseline · Sends and saves (one goal per video) · Conversions: leads, sales, ROAS · Untangle: one variable at a time)
- [Research method](research-method.md): Where do ideas and references come from? (Study one same-niche creator deeply · 5 in-niche for topics, 5 outside for packaging · Study the viewer's whole feed · Audience questions and niche forums · Trend scan)
- [Planning level](planning.md): How much is decided before the camera rolls? (Storyboard every beat · Light script from a framework · Improvise with pauses (ReCut) · Press play and just post)
- [AI's role](ai-role.md): What job does AI do in making the content? (AI as editor · AI writes the plan, you approve · AI for ideas and research only · AI for craft jobs (sound, motion, measuring))
- [Using other creators' content](using-others-content.md): Do other people's reels appear in ours, and how? (Original only · Pause-and-play breakdown · Commentary proven on your own footage · Study privately, remake the style)
